_说明: 雅思口语 Part 2 题卡，按主话题 group 归类（见 topic-groups.json 的 key）。新增题按此格式加进对应 group 即可。

education.title: Describe a skill you would like to learn
education.cn: 描述一项你想学的技能
cues: and explain why you want to learn it

education.title: Describe a teacher who has influenced you
education.cn: 描述一位影响过你的老师
cues: and explain how they influenced you

education.title: Describe something useful you learned outside school
education.cn: 描述一件你在学校之外学到的有用的东西
cues: and explain why it was useful

society.title: Describe a job you would like to do in the future
society.cn: 描述你未来想做的一份工作
cues: why you are interested in it
and explain whether it is easy to get

society.title: Describe a person who has helped you
society.cn: 描述一个帮助过你的人
cues: and explain how you felt about it

society.title: Describe a piece of good news you received
society.cn: 描述你收到的一个好消息
cues: and explain why it was good news

city.title: Describe a city you have visited
city.cn: 描述一座你去过的城市
cues: and explain what you liked about it

city.title: Describe a public place you like to go
city.cn: 描述一个你喜欢去的公共场所
cues: and explain why you like it

city.title: Describe a long journey you enjoyed
city.cn: 描述一段你享受的长途旅行
cues: and explain why you enjoyed it

nature.title: Describe a place with beautiful scenery
nature.cn: 描述一个风景优美的地方
cues: and explain how you felt there

nature.title: Describe an environmental problem in your area
nature.cn: 描述你所在地区的一个环境问题
cues: and explain how it could be solved

nature.title: Describe a wild animal you find interesting
nature.cn: 描述一种你觉得有趣的野生动物
cues: and explain why you find it interesting

tech.title: Describe a website or app you often use
tech.cn: 描述一个你常用的网站或应用
cues: and explain why it is useful to you

tech.title: Describe a piece of technology you find useful
tech.cn: 描述一件你觉得有用的科技产品
cues: how long you have had it
and explain why it is useful

tech.title: Describe a time technology helped you solve a problem
tech.cn: 描述科技帮你解决问题的一次经历
cues: and explain how you felt afterwards

culture.title: Describe a festival you enjoy
culture.cn: 描述一个你喜欢的节日
cues: and explain why you enjoy it

culture.title: Describe a hobby you have had for a long time
culture.cn: 描述一个你坚持很久的爱好
cues: and explain why you have kept it

culture.title: Describe a book you enjoyed reading
culture.cn: 描述一本你喜欢读的书
cues: and explain why you enjoyed it
